listening.title: Listening Practice
listening.subtitle: Listen to short stories, build your comprehension — then test yourself with a quiz. Completely free.

hero.title: Train your ears, master English
hero.subtitle: One short story a day — build a listening habit and understand more, faster.

apiKey.title: Add your Gemini API Key in Settings
apiKey.description: Listening stories are generated by AI. Grab a free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey — it's encrypted and stored safely, and every story is cached on the server once created.

steps.topicHint: Tap a card to hear a story about that topic.

player.noTts: Voice playback isn't supported in this browser — you can still read along and take the quiz.
player.noParagraphs: No paragraphs were found in this story.
player.totalParagraphs: {n} paragraphs in total — they'll be read one by one when you press Listen
player.tipListenFirst: Tip: listen to the story at least once before answering — it makes understanding much easier.

quiz.noQuestions: No questions were found for this story.
quiz.msgPerfect: Outstanding! You understood the whole story — keep it up! 🎉
quiz.msgGreat: Very good! A little more practice and you'll feel even more confident.
quiz.msgGood: Good try! Listen to the story once more, then take the quiz again.
quiz.msgKeep: No worries — listen to the story slowly at 0.75x speed, understand it, then try again.
